يستحقوا (form X)
# يَسْتَحِقُّوا (yastaḥiqqū) /jas.ta.ħiq.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# يُسْتَحَقُّوا (yustaḥaqqū) /jus.ta.ħaq.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
